resources.string: Take a new picture or select one from your photo library. ColumbiaWalks uses the picture’s GPS when available, or falls back to your current device location. You can review or manually override the coordinates before submission. A description is optional. Submitting sends the photo to an administrator for Page of Shame approval.
Open the camera to take a picture for this report
Choose an existing picture from the photo library for this report
Your current picture stays attached unless the new picture finishes preparing successfully.
Preparing picture and checking its GPS coordinates…
Picture selected for this Page of Shame report
Picture GPS will be checked first; device GPS or manual coordinates can be used instead.
Location permission was not granted. Enter coordinates manually, or allow location access and retry GPS.
Current GPS could not be confirmed. Enter coordinates manually, or move outdoors, enable Location, and retry.
Use or refresh this device’s GPS coordinates
Review the report location or enter latitude and longitude manually
Add only what the picture does not show.
Submit this Page of Shame picture with the confirmed location
Picture ready. Waiting for device GPS, then it will submit automatically. You can enter coordinates instead.
Take or select a picture before submitting.
Would you like to add details?
Submit now uses the location shown. Review location lets you inspect or override coordinates first. Add details opens the optional description box.
Review the current coordinates or enter replacements. Original picture GPS coordinates remain attached as provenance when you override them.
Submitted for administrator review. Approved photos will appear on the public Page of Shame.
Saved locally. ColumbiaWalks will retry the administrator submission when service is available.
The PoS picture could not be saved. Please try again.
Submitting sends this photo and optional description to ColumbiaWalks for administrator review before publication. Avoid faces, children, private property details, or other sensitive information.
